extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (Linux Desktop) (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for Linux Desktop. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an integrated watchdog thread with automatic interface and route recovery to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for Linux Desktop. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news:
v1.0.5 (2026-09-18)
- Changed: Watchdog migrated from systemd user-unit to integrated Kodi service thread - Changed: Legacy vpn-watchdog.service is stopped and removed automatically on upgrade - Added: Watchdog activity visible in kodi.log with self-healing loop - Added: Session gate prevents helper spawns on boot without active session - Added: Connector lock logging reduced to once-per-event (no more spam) - Added: Helper subprocess logging to standalone_wm.log with timestamp and PID - Added: Log rotation on Kodi restart (standalone_wm.log → .old) - Added: TUNNELLING toast shown during silent reconnect attempts - Improved: Service resolver speed from 7s to under 30ms via prefix filtering and exact-match fast-path - Improved: IPv6 management now targets only physical adapters, cutting disconnect time from 7s to under 1s and full location switches from 16s to under 3s
